annotations.title: Quote a cross-chain buy without paying

description: Reads the gateway's HTTP 402 challenge for a market and returns the quote and payment requirements without spending anything. The challenge carries the exact amount, the asset, the payTo address and the EIP-3009 domain, so an agent can decide before it signs. Free. This is the tool to call before buy_token.

chainId.description: Chain id of the market, for a ticker that trades on more than one chain (list_markets shows chainId). Without it the oldest market for that ticker is used.

symbol.description: Market ticker, for example PARCEL or ADEXTO. Required and has no default: the gateway refuses a missing ticker rather than quoting one, so a typo can never bill you for a token you did not ask for. Call list_markets first if you do not know it.

to.description: Recipient address for the tokens. Optional for a quote; the curve delivers straight to it on a real buy.

name: quote_buy

challenge.description: The gateway's answer: on 402, x402Version, accepts[0] with the payment terms, and quote.

httpStatus.description: Status the gateway answered: 402 is a quote.

quoted.description: True when the gateway returned a 402 quote.

title: Quote a cross-chain buy without paying
